long_biography.plain_text:
Trained as a chartered accountant, Marcel Martinus Jacobus Johannes Boekhoorn joined Deloitte and became its youngest partner. He left to found Ramphastos Investments in 1994, applying his accounting and deal experience to companies overlooked by other investors. Rather than relying on one operating business, he built wealth by acquiring stakes, improving growth and attracting strategic buyers. Exits from Bakker Bart, Motip Dupli and other businesses established the model; the acquisition and resale of Telfort became its defining financial success.

Ramphastos invests its own capital across financial services, retail, technology, manufacturing and energy. The price paid by KPN for Telfort, portfolio-company revenues and company valuations belong to different accounting categories; none directly measures Boekhoorn's current personal wealth. In 2023 he handed day-to-day management to Jan Willem Neggers, remaining actively involved as founder and major shareholder.
